skill.name: impress
skill.description: Create, edit, convert, and automate LibreOffice Impress presentations in ODP, PPTX, PDF, HTML, and related formats.
skill.summary: Automate LibreOffice Impress presentation creation, conversion, and template-based slide workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation for LibreOffice Impress workflows and does not contain prompt injection or malicious intent. Most static hits are Markdown fences, documentation links, or local conversion examples; the confirmed risks are the Python subprocess examples that call zip and unzip on caller-controlled paths.

remediation.issue: Template generation uses external zip and unzip commands on caller-controlled paths.
remediation.suggestion: Use a safe archive library, validate input and output paths, reject traversal entries, and document that untrusted presentation files need inspection before extraction.

remediation.issue: LibreOffice command examples can process arbitrary local files when copied into automation.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to quote file paths, restrict allowed directories, and review files before batch conversion.

remediation.issue: The UNO listener troubleshooting command opens a local automation service.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the listener bound to localhost and shut it down after the task completes.

content.value_statement: Presentation work often needs repeatable creation, conversion, and batch updates. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through LibreOffice Impress workflows.
actual_capabilities: Create new ODP presentations using LibreOffice Impress workflows.
Convert presentations between ODP, PPTX, PDF, HTML, and related formats.
Generate presentations from templates with scripted content replacement.
Automate slide creation and batch processing with LibreOffice command-line tools.
Use Python UNO examples for advanced presentation document automation.
Reference supported formats, command patterns, and troubleshooting steps.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice and related command-line tools to be installed locally.
Conversion fidelity can vary across fonts, media, transitions, and complex layouts.
Template examples need path validation before use with untrusted files.
The skill provides guidance and examples, not a complete presentation design engine.

use_cases.title: Build Recurring Reports
use_cases.description: Generate ODP decks from repeatable templates and export PDF copies for distribution.

use_cases.title: Convert Existing Decks
use_cases.description: Batch convert ODP, PPTX, and PDF presentation files for review, sharing, or archive workflows.

use_cases.title: Prototype Presentation Automation
use_cases.description: Use UNO and command-line examples to test automated slide creation and template workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ODP presentation outline with five slides for a quarterly team update. Include slide titles and brief speaker notes.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Presentation Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare safe LibreOffice commands to convert all ODP files in this folder to PDF. Explain any path safety checks first.

prompt_templates.title: Generate from a Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a template-based Impress workflow that replaces approved placeholders with project data and exports both ODP and PDF outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Automate with UNO
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Python UNO automation flow that creates a presentation, adds slides, inserts charts, saves ODP, and closes LibreOffice cleanly.

output_examples.input: Create a sales update deck and export it as PDF.
output_examples.output: A slide plan with title, agenda, pipeline summary, regional performance, risks, next actions, and export steps for PDF delivery.

output_examples.input: Batch convert several ODP files to PPTX.
output_examples.output: A conversion checklist covering file backup, quoted paths, LibreOffice headless conversion, output verification, and handling failed files.

output_examples.input: Generate slides from a reusable template.
output_examples.output: A template workflow that maps placeholders to approved data, validates input files, creates an ODP copy, and reviews the finished presentation.

best_practices: Keep editable ODP source files under version control before conversion.
Validate file paths and templates before running batch or archive operations.
Test converted decks visually before sharing final PPTX or PDF files.
anti_patterns: Do not run template extraction on untrusted presentation files without validation.
Do not assume PPTX or PDF output will preserve every animation or font.
Do not leave a LibreOffice UNO listener running after automation is complete.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It guides LibreOffice Impress presentation creation, conversion, template generation, and basic command-line automation.

faq.question: Does it require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows depend on LibreOffice Impress, soffice, and optional Python UNO support.

faq.question: Can it convert PPTX to ODP?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for converting PPTX, PPT, PDF, and ODP formats with LibreOffice.

faq.question: Can it create slides from data?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes template-based generation and batch slide creation patterns.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted files?
faq.answer: Use caution. Validate paths and inspect templates before extraction, conversion, or batch processing.

faq.question: Does it design complete presentations automatically?
faq.answer: It provides workflows and automation guidance. Final visual design review remains the user responsibility.
